label: synthetic demand, uncalibrated
title: 08:30 ambulance from Al Wasita to King Khalid Hospital; a crash since 08:25 blocks one of four lanes on its route (fictional)

options.label: Route A + signal preemption
options.reason: Route A + signal preemption gets the ambulance there in 211 s, 3 s slower than no strategy (208 s); it avoids `326232104`, where the no-strategy ambulance spent 14 s and preempting 2 signals saves 6 s against the same route without it. Over the 300 s horizon it saves 0.04 vehicle-hours of background delay versus no strategy; the longest queue on its route was 9 halted vehicles on `1358424025#10`.

options.label: Route A + preemption + rescue lane
options.reason: Route A + preemption + rescue lane gets the ambulance there in 214 s, 6 s slower than no strategy (208 s); it avoids `326232104`, where the no-strategy ambulance spent 14 s; it also preempts 2 signals and reserves a rescue lane on 14 edges. Over the 300 s horizon it saves 0.05 vehicle-hours of background delay versus no strategy; the longest queue on its route was 27 halted vehicles on `1358424025#10`.

options.label: Route A only
options.reason: Route A only gets the ambulance there in 217 s, 9 s slower than no strategy (208 s); it avoids `326232104`, where the no-strategy ambulance spent 14 s. Over the 300 s horizon it adds 0.05 vehicle-hours of background delay versus no strategy; the longest queue on its route was 8 halted vehicles on `1358424025#10`.

A-sim-001.assumption: Scales the expected signal delay of a red phase on meso edges; SUMO docs suggest 0.5-1. No Hail signal timing data. Range 0.3-1.0; revisit in the M2 meso-vs-micro fidelity test.

A-sim-002.assumption: Seconds a vehicle may stand still before SUMO teleports it; SUMO default. Governs the teleport acceptance metric (< 0.5 %). Range 120-600.
